arguments.prompt: In the fde-station repo (private apt channel enrollment tooling), find the script responsible for enrolling a machine onto the apt channel (likely named enroll.sh or similar). I need precise, verifiable file:line citations for: (1) which script owns the enrollment process, (2) every destination file path it writes on the target machine (e.g. apt sources list file, keyring file, auth/credential conf file), (3) how the apt source entry is tied to the GPG keyring (the exact apt source line syntax referencing the keyring, e.g. signed-by), and (4) the exact permission mode (chmod value) set on the credential/PAT file, and the line of code that sets it. Quote the relevant code lines for each.
